spell.truenins.infinity.guide: Unfold an impassable wall. For 600 ticks you gain Infinity and Skyward, plus Speed II and Regeneration II for 30 seconds. After the flight ends Infinity remains, but drains 4 health every 20 ticks until you can no longer pay; the rain stops when Infinity does.
truenins.tag.blackflash.name: Black Flash
truenins.tag.blackflash.desc: A 1% chance to land a Black Flash: tenfold damage and the target is hurled ten blocks straight back
spell.truenins.made_in_heaven.guide: Time accelerates. The sky spins, day turns to night, and everything nearby is dragged along with it.
spell.truenins.curse_zone.guide: Unfold a cursed zone. The zone has no time limit, but it can only produce three Black Flashes; casting it again refills them. Black Flashes born from the zone also give mana back.
spell.truenins.ao.guide: The right hand rises smoothly in front of the face and a pale blue sphere forms on the palm, then is flung out. The sphere circles the caster, dragging nearby creatures onto itself and grinding them down.
spell.truenins.he.guide: The right hand rises smoothly in front of the face and a deep red sphere forms on the palm, then is flung out. The sphere flies dead straight, tearing through every block and creature on its path.
